chunks.text: # Corporate Travel and Event Policy (Document Ref: PRISM-2026-POL)

§ 1.0 General Administration & Governance This policy establishes standard corporate travel, accommodation, and event expenditure standards for all participating team members and contractors. Compliance with these operational instructions is mandatory across all regional divisions.

§ 2.1 Reimbursement Limits & Expense Allowances All standard business meals are eligible for reimbursement up to the established reimbursement limits. The maximum daily reimbursement limits for domestic travel shall not exceed $150 per day, inclusive of breakfast ($30), lunch ($45), and dinner ($75). Lodging reimbursement limits are capped at $250 per night excluding state occupancy taxes. Any individual expense exceeding $50 requires a verified itemized receipt submitted via the automated portal within fifteen business days. Reimbursement limits may only be overridden with prior written consent from the department director.

§ 3.4 Cancellation Terms & Refund Conditions Event registration and travel bookings are subject to strict cancellation terms. Cancellations submitted more than 30 days prior to the scheduled event date will receive a full 100% refund of all registration fees. Cancellations submitted between 14 and 30 days prior will incur a 25% administrative fee under standard cancellation terms. Any cancellation notice provided less than 14 days before the event is non-refundable unless resulting from an unforeseen medical emergency. All cancellation requests must be transmitted formally in writing.

§ 4.0 Security & Corpus Compliance Mandates Participants must adhere to the data privacy and security baseline established in SRD-SLRAG-001. All retrieved documentation is subject to strict local corpus isolation without unverified network transmission.
